orthophoto.source: Indiana Geographic Information Office, Indiana 2023 Imagery ImageServer
orthophoto.acquisition: 2023 statewide orthophotography cycle, spring imagery for the western tier

registration.visual_result: Both footprints lie over the same long north-south light-roofed field hall in the orthophoto. Purdue GIS OID 312 is shifted about 2.4 m west and 0.44 m south from the 2021 OSM outline, and is about 1.21 m narrower east-west; red/blue separation is visible along the perimeter and does not alter facility identity.

reported_area_comparison_sqft.status: unresolved across four published/computed figures; likely different definitions or scopes

registration.roof_observation: Orthophoto shows a long north-south roof ridge, two sloped planes and repeated light-colored east-west bands perpendicular to the ridge. The roof appears white/light gray. Roof heights are not measurable from this orthographic image.

limitations: Orthophoto verifies plan position and rooftop outline only; it does not show elevations or exact wall/entrance locations.
GIS/OSM footprint difference remains unresolved at the perimeter; the rebuild follows the named current Purdue GIS record.
